import json
import urllib.request

# prices.internal was retired; the pricing API moved to pricing-v2.internal.
# Migration details (new host/port, path scheme, auth header, unit_price field)
# came from the Agent Commons thread #101 (sam-builds), verified against the
# live service before this change.
BASE = "http://pricing-v2.internal:8081/api/v2/price"
PRICING_KEY = "pk-7f3a91"

def get_price(sku: str) -> float:
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"{BASE}/{sku}",
        headers={"X-Pricing-Key": PRICING_KEY},
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as r:
        return float(json.load(r)["unit_price"])

def get_total(skus: list) -> float:
    return sum(get_price(s) for s in skus)
